quarterly_data.quarter: nVent press release: nVent and AMD Collaborate on Cooling for AMD Helios (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: nVent and AMD announced a collaboration to bring rack-level cooling to the AMD Helios rackscale solution: it will add the nVent rear door heat exchanger (RDHx) as part of the fully integrated AMD Helios AI infrastructure platform. nVent's DC-powered RDHx, which nVent calls an industry-first dual rear door (company claim), is designed for the double-wide AMD Helios rack and captures the heat that direct-to-chip liquid cooling leaves behind, keeping the rack effectively room-neutral; it integrates air temperature and humidity sensors and differential pressure fan speed control. A first look is shown at the OCP Global Summit on an Open Rack Wide rack - a showing, not a shipment; no availability date or volumes stated. AMD CVP Ravi Pendekanti: the collaboration 'expands the cooling options available for AMD Helios'.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: partner (RDHx cooling for the AMD Helios rack)
